sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Flint axe is the second one-handed axe. It can be used to chop down Beech, Fir and Pine trees.
Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its secondary attack is a slow but powerful overhead swing. This is perfect for removing tree stumps that are too low to hit with a normal swing.

Introduction. The Flint axe is the second one-handed axe. It can be used to chop down Beech, Fir and Pine trees.
Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its secondary attack is a slow but powerful overhead swing. This is perfect for removing tree stumps that are too low to hit with a normal swing.
